notes.text: Rick Buy asked Wanda Curry to lead a cross-functional Operational Risk Committee under the Risk Management Policy, with representatives from Enron Assurance Services, RAC, Research, IT, GRMO and Arthur Andersen. Wanda will contact each recipient, including the owner, for a designated contact.

Rick Buy set the committee's initial goal as a baseline or report card of operational risk, to be completed before year-end 2001. Its objectives include spreadsheet V@R/MTM monitoring, intercompany-interbook monitoring and recommending quantitative operational risk metrics.

Sally Beck said Operations will name a person for Rick Buy's operational risk project. She proposed a kick-off meeting to clarify how it relates to EAS, AA internal audit, London self-assessment and Doorstep reviews, and said implementation should rest with business units outside RAC.

Sally Beck said Project Greenlight already covers the integrity of daily risk reports (data from all source systems into RisktRAC). It is a global effort with a steering committee, worked out with Debbie Brackett and agreed with Rick Buy in August.

Sally Beck said stakeholders from Operations, IT and Debbie Brackett would review the Project Greenlight plan with David Port and Bill Bradford. She asked that the RisktRAC data-integrity item be removed from Wanda Curry's list if Rick Buy approves Greenlight.
